title: He, she, Anna: the plain stem

sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: For *ő* (“he, she”) or for a name the verb has no ending at all: it is the plain stem you see in the vocabulary lists. *Anna olvas.* means “Anna reads.” The name or *ő* tells the listener who it is.

Never add an ending to the verb because it follows a name. *Olvasok* always means “I read”, so *Anna olvasok* is wrong. You will later meet verbs that end in *-ik* in this form; they work a little differently.
